description: Compact after a duplicate-key index grew: 400 more rows with G = 7 are inserted into IxD (300 rows with G = 7 and index IX_IxD_G), by one statement. Then DBEngine.CompactDatabase of the mutated file into a work file (the mutated file is unchanged); the public state is read before the mutation, after it and from the compacted file.  Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive. The compacted file is kept as a separate derivative (after-compact).
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
